title: renders Basis before Optional and groups multiple roles into one Bedarfsplan category card
reason: Three items and repeated category roles: Basis precedes Optional, grouping/card counts and routine overview labels. Single-item banner/toast renders cannot detect a broken grouping map.

reason: Proposal/no-active header excludes journey-header/progress orientation. Retain: other proposal fixtures exercise different item/status subtrees; no ready transfer to an unchanged exact fixture established.

reason: Chosen catalog product is a full routine member despite planned availability. Null-product gap keeper cannot catch accidental provisional/readiness regressions.

reason: Oil heat capability metadata plus counterexamples controls verified leaf facts; generic product-ready assertion cannot detect incorrectly inferred heat protection.

reason: Active product-led layout with included, excluded, later and informed-override products. The single default Shampoo renders do not traverse these partitions or legacy fit fallback.

reason: v3 replacement presentation, current Aktiv/no Noch kaufen, retained old product exactly once, detail gating and empty-retained variant. Keep actual current UI replacing dormant acquisition label semantics.

reason: v4 retained inventory must display stored non-executable context, distinct schema/version field from v3 retained owned products.

title: explains confirmed unnecessary heat protection in the not-planned routine section
reason: Confirmed unnecessary heat protection renders the specific explanation in not-planned section. This is a current positive category/reason branch absent in default cards.

reason: Basis gap and no-payload recovery are different executable/readiness paths; no-banner/toast negatives do not prove either.

reason: Non-executable pending/planned/excluded conditions and global edit semantics; preserve each existing input rather than fold the multi-state cases into an unrelated keeper.

reason: Each server deferral reason produces its own visible recovery text/link; category-only placeholder render cannot distinguish reasons.

reason: Excluded item with missing matching decision key retains generic copy. Reason-positive fixtures cannot catch accidental category-based lookup.

title: a role a later recompute resolved is no longer excluded, so its placeholder disappears with no extra clearing logic
reason: Already resolved included item ignores stale server deferral metadata. This is a renderer test, not actual recompute lifecycle coverage; keep the different inclusion readset.

title: the all-deferred shape (zero-recommendation accept) renders only placeholders
reason: All-deferred zero-product payload gives honest subtitle, two recovery links, no readiness/application CTA. Mixed active/pending cards cannot establish zero-product branch.

reason: Mask biweekly cadence and prewash Oil role produce exact composed cadence+timing text with no internal keys. Scalar helper table uses other intervals/roles and no composed card output.

title: presents every structured cadence kind and keeps a user override authoritative
reason: Nine distinct structured cadence variants plus authoritative user override; no exact existing render set establishes every fallback/interval/event/protocol output. Do not regroup cases for credit.

title: fresh state (products open, 2 von 4): banner renders above the routine blocks
reason: Products-module 2/4 copy, 2-minute CTA, placement plus actual leaf button callbacks. Habits 3/4 coexistence keeper does not establish module-specific copy or these callback counters.

title: post-module-1 state (habits open, 3 von 4): banner renders above the routine blocks too
reason: C6: same habits banner readset as existing coexistence render; transfer progress, CTA duration and before-Basis ordering.

reason: C3: null refinementBanner equals default null; same active payload and absent handlers. Transfer all three negative copy assertions to existing withoutFlag SSR.

reason: C4: byte-equivalent effective props to existing withoutFlag SSR. Transfer no-dismiss and no-progress assertions (deduplicate identical no-dismiss assertion).

reason: C5: toast receives only same onDismiss; optional banner does not affect toast props/slot. Transfer role=status and before-Basis ordering to existing coexistence SSR.

reason: Canonical existing three renders independently cover missing signal, explicit false signal, and missing dismiss callback; keep these inputs and add C3/C4 negatives only to withoutFlag.

title: Task 2.6: the plan-updated toast and the refinement banner can render on the same visit
reason: Canonical existing coexistence render proves both live slots; C5/C6 union adds public status/progress/duration/ordering without another render.

title: Routine resolver preserves legacy only for people without a Personal Plan
reason: Legacy/no-plan, paid stage4 disabled and stage5 access exercise distinct route resolver gates; stage4-enabled recovery cannot catch legacy demotion or stage5 reachability coupling.

reason: Actual readView throw must produce unavailable, never legacy. Healthy resolver keeper cannot catch fail-open legacy substitution.

reason: No active version + initial candidate resolves portfolio source from candidate payload; active portfolio API keeper selects active version and cannot catch this source-choice branch.

title: Routine resolver threads the refinement banner view model through from readRefinementBanner
reason: Actual resolver forwards same user to banner dependency and returns complete products 2/4 view model. Rendering a supplied model cannot catch missing route delivery.

title: Routine resolver degrades to no banner when readRefinementBanner is absent or fails
reason: Missing optional dependency and thrown banner lookup degrade to null while preserving plan. Success-path banner keeper cannot catch presentation failure taking down route.

title: Routine unavailable recovery offers an explicit reload action
reason: Existing identical recovery SSR plus retry callback and router.refresh source binding; retain and add exact forward link from C1.

title: Routine unavailable recovery also offers a forward CTA out of the dead end
reason: C1: identical recovery SSR and retry props; forward-link regex is sole unique assertion, transferred into existing html.

reason: Stage3 frontier denies view construction and observes no read. Healthy stage4 view and rendered unavailable state cannot prove acquisition gate.

reason: Manual hook harness edits actual complete editor; selected replacement plus category/role operations reach submit callback as exact batch. SSR-only card layouts cannot prove handler composition.

reason: Unsupported roles/cadences disable controls and dirty cancel requires explicit discard; verifies callback count before/after discard. Clean editor keeper omits this state transition.

title: Routine discard confirmation uses the reviewed visible actions
reason: Rendered discard dialog copy/actions/safe-area styling; dirty-handler keeper invokes body callbacks but does not render this exact confirmation output.

title: global editor starts at the recommendation and can clear a cadence override
reason: Actual cadence select starts at recommendation, captures explicit override then clears to null; replacement batch keeper cannot catch empty-select normalization.

title: routine client never renders raw server error tokens
reason: Actual friendlyError sanitizes unauthorized and raw internal errors consumed by client catches; no current mounted catch-path keeper with those same error inputs established.

title: Routine entry never blocks actions and defers reconciliation behind a pending proposal
reason: Actual sync timing predicate preserves immediate interaction and pending-proposal delay; effect is a current caller. This direct helper does not prove mounted scheduling, retained as bounded timing policy.

title: the entry sync reloads for a healed module recompute, not only for a staged proposal
reason: Sync result healed-module/changed-proposal booleans and legacy empty result control reload. Existing acceptance refresh helper exercises another return protocol.

title: successor proposals are available from the overview but never auto-open on entry
reason: Initial proposal sheet-open policy evaluates active/pending combinations; live state initializer calls helper. No current mounted initialization keeper established; no auto-open lifecycle claim.

title: proposal sheet body separates initial confirmation from successor review callbacks
reason: Actual initial/successor body buttons route distinct accept/reject callbacks and labels. Busy-button fixture never exercises these handler choices.

title: proposal acceptance reload distinguishes lost response, same pending, and supersession
reason: Reload classifier differentiates same proposal, disappearance/lost response and supersession identities; provider-free visual proposal tests cannot detect wrong identity classification.

title: every Routine acceptance refreshes server-owned navigation and portfolio presentation
reason: Actual accept refresh helper performs server navigation/presentation refresh with independent accept versus reject paths. SSR sheet callback counters stop before this owner.

reason: F1: only disabled submit and progress text under isSubmitting=true are asserted. Removing actual client duplicate-request guard while leaving prop rendering intact survives; narrow title, no deletion or new quota.

reason: Frozen delta labels map item keys to consumer names/categories including null-active added path. Ordinary item cards do not render direct/consequential delta lists.

reason: Actual detail body exposes frozen fit plus supplied commerce and explicit action callback; owned detail suppresses purchase CTA. Item overview tests do not exercise detail commerce boundary.

reason: Visible accessible pending-proposal attention dot and absent false state, layout-independent position. Client proposal state helpers do not render this navigation marker.

reason: C2: exact same v3Snapshot/id triple is loaded by existing real GET. Transfer ordered portfolio-table eq receipt and schemaVersion; retained name is already asserted as exact one-element array.

reason: Keep live fitLabelFor v3 informed_override and null legacy contracts pending optional dormant-method decision; if plannedLabelFor is retired, remove only its two obsolete assertions. Current actual card calls fitLabelFor.

reason: v4 parser/presentation preserves retained inventory as display-only exact data and schema4; v3 GET cannot prove v4 branch. Remove only obsolete plannedLabelFor assertion if optional retirement accepted.

reason: Strict unknown-field stored snapshot rejects. Healthy API fake returning valid v3 schema cannot prove malformed-storage fail-closed behavior.

reason: D1 conditional: entire sole assertion is unused plannedLabelFor acquisition copy. categoryResolutions is validated structurally but not read by this label projection; no separate current pending-to-ready business oracle here. History explicitly retained this future seam, so excluded from six ready cuts.

reason: Preserve exact live plannedPurchaseDecisionKeys JSON projection for no-owned-source planned purchase. Retiring unused label must not delete live field assertion or this distinct parser input.

reason: Three server deferral reasons map by decision key; ordinary planned gap without reason is excluded. Card fixture directly supplies map and cannot catch reader dropping or miskeying it.

reason: One userProductId serving two replaced roles deduplicates retained products while retaining both decision keys; default single-role GET cannot catch deduplication regression.

title: profile presentation API authenticates, owner-scopes its active portfolio, and returns JSON-safe arrays
reason: Existing actual authenticated GET obtains active plan→version→portfolio and returns no-store JSON; transfer C2 scope receipts into existing query observations, no new load calls.

reason: Live RoutineCard uses visual action map; six kinds and legacy text-only exception produce distinct actions/labels/dot. Stage4 cards use another component/model.

reason: Live chat trigger consumes German reason descriptions; pending and suggestion text are protocol payloads as well as display strings, not unused presentation exports.

reason: Live frequency control uses exact slider stops/band/preferred coordinates and below-target label; scalar cadence UI uses different model and cannot catch geometry regression.
